news.title: Final dividend of ₹19.25 announced
news.body: Shareholders will receive a dividend of ₹19.25. Ex-date: 14th August 2026 Payment date: 1st January 1970 Dividend yield will be 6.6%, which is higher than the industry average of 1.8%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is well covered by both earnings (29% earnings payout ratio) and cash flows (19% cash payout ratio). The dividend has increased by an average of 21% per year over the past 10 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. EPS is expected to decline by 53% over the next 3 years. However, it would need to fall by 68% to increase the payout ratio to a potentially unsustainable range.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹84.81 (up from ₹31.66 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹4.40t (up 1.8% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹180.5b (up 168% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 4.1% (up from 1.6% in FY 2025). Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 4.7%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 23%. Revenue is forecast to grow 5.0% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 6.4% growth forecast for the Oil and Gas industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 25% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 31% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Investor sentiment deteriorates as stock falls 15%
news.body: After last week's 15% share price decline to ₹325, the stock trades at a forward P/E ratio of 5x. Average forward P/E is 11x in the Oil and Gas industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 120% over the past three years. Simply Wall St's valuation model estimates the intrinsic value at ₹383 per share.

news.title: HINDPETRO: New Energy MoUs Will Keep P/E Risks Elevated

What's in the News Indian Gas Exchange (IGX) and Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) signed an MoU during India Energy Week 2026 in Goa to improve access to regasification infrastructure and deepen market-based participation in India's natural gas ecosystem (Key Developments).

news.title: HINDPETRO: New Energy MoUs Will Not Offset Rich P/E Risks
news.body: Analysts now place Hindustan Petroleum's fair value at about ₹357, up from roughly ₹350, reflecting updated assumptions on the discount rate, revenue trends, profit margins and future P/E. What's in the News Indian Gas Exchange and Hindustan Petroleum signed an MoU at India Energy Week 2026 to provide a digital platform for transparent booking of regasification services at HPCL's Chhara LNG terminal, with HPCL offering storage and regasification capacity in set quantities and durations (Key Developments).

news.title: Now 21% overvalued
news.body: Over the last 90 days, the stock has fallen 6.5% to ₹453. The fair value is estimated to be ₹374, however this is not to be taken as a sell recommendation but rather should be used as a guide only. Revenue has been flat over the last 3 years. Meanwhile, the company has become profitable. Revenue is forecast to grow by 0.04% in 2 years. Earnings are forecast to decline by 14% in the next 2 years.

Revenue is forecast to grow 2.1% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 5.5% growth forecast for the Oil and Gas industry in India.
